name: foundry-ui
description: Open-source agent UI starter — AG-UI protocol, Microsoft Agent Framework, Azure Foundry. Cross-runtime transport + React shell.

scripts.test: pnpm build && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:unit
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @iloveagents/foundry-agent build && pnpm --filter @iloveagents/foundry-web-primitives build && pnpm --filter @iloveagents/foundry-web-ui build && pnpm --filter @iloveagents/foundry-web-shell build && pnpm --filter create-foundry-ui-app build
